steps.name: Chip Off the Rust Scale
steps.hint: Scratch the chisel across each flaking lump until it breaks off.

steps.name: Electrolysis Bath
steps.hint: Drag the lock into the soda bath, clip on both leads, then hold the button.
steps.done: Rust turned to soft black sludge

steps.name: Free the Stuck Key
steps.hint: Hold the torch on the keyhole until it glows, then twist the key out.

steps.name: Split the Body Open
steps.hint: Strike the chisel into the seam at each mark.

steps.name: Wire-Wheel to Bright Steel
steps.hint: Run the wire wheel over every part until the black turns to bright steel.

steps.name: Cold-Blue the Iron
steps.hint: Brush the bluing over the steel for a deep blue-black finish.

steps.name: Refit the Lock Parts
steps.hint: Drag the levers, shackle and face plate back into place.

steps.name: Peen the Rivets
steps.hint: Strike each rivet when the needle is in the green.

steps.name: Key Test
steps.hint: Drag the key to turn it: the shackle springs open. Close it again, twice.
steps.done: It works with its original key!

steps.name: Before and After
steps.hint: Drag the slider across to compare the object you started with against your restoration.

steps.name: Knock Off the Rust Crust
steps.hint: Scratch the chisel across each lump of rust until it breaks off.
steps.done: The shape of a knife appears

steps.name: Open the Seam
steps.hint: Trace the burr along the line where blade and handle are fused.

steps.name: Electrolysis
steps.hint: Lower the knife into the jar, then hold the button to run the current.

steps.name: Scrape the Black Scale
steps.hint: Scrape off the black scale the electrolysis loosened.

steps.name: Wire-Wheel Reveal
steps.hint: Run the wire wheel over the knife. Bright steel appears under the grey.

steps.name: Punch Out the Pins
steps.hint: Tap each pin twice to drive it out.

steps.name: Sharpen the Blade
steps.hint: Make long strokes along the edge while keeping the angle needle in the green.

steps.name: Forge a New Bail Ring
steps.hint: Heat the wire until it glows, then circle to bend it round.

steps.name: Oil Finish & Rivet Together
steps.hint: Brush the protective oil over the steel. The knife goes back together when it is coated.

steps.name: Flick It Open
steps.hint: Swing the blade open, then fold it shut. Do it twice.

steps.name: Before and After
steps.hint: Drag the slider across to compare the object you started with against your restoration.

steps.name: Knock Out the Rivets
steps.hint: Tap each rivet head twice to drive it out of the handle.

steps.name: Pull Off the Handle
steps.hint: Grab the grip and slide it straight off the tang.

steps.name: Pick Off the Deep Rust
steps.hint: Scratch each crusty lump until it breaks off.

steps.name: Wash Off the Residue
steps.hint: Scrub the black film away with the soapy brush.

steps.name: Grind Out the Flaws
steps.hint: Press the grinder on each marked flaw and hold.

steps.name: File the Edges
steps.hint: Stroke the file along both edges of the blade.

steps.name: Polish the Blade
steps.hint: Buff in small circles until the blade becomes a mirror.

steps.name: Restore the Handle
steps.hint: Brush warm stain over the grip. Turn it to reach the other side.

steps.name: Reattach the Handle
steps.hint: Carry the grip to the glowing outline on the tang.

steps.name: Hammer the Rivets Home
steps.hint: Strike each brass rivet when the needle is in the green.

steps.name: Before and After
steps.hint: Drag the slider across to compare the object you started with against your restoration.

steps.name: Remove the Outer Shell
steps.hint: Grab the case and slide it straight down off the insert.

steps.name: Remove the Old Cotton
steps.hint: Pull out each lump of old cotton with the tweezers.

steps.name: Remove the Hinge Pin
steps.hint: Tap the hinge pin three times to knock it out.

steps.name: Remove the Flint Wheel
steps.hint: Pinch the flint wheel and lift it out.

steps.name: Sand the Damaged Spots
steps.hint: Press the sanding wheel on each marked flaw and hold.

steps.name: Polish the Main Body
steps.hint: Buff the parts in circles until they gleam.

steps.name: Reassemble the Mechanism
steps.hint: Drag the flint wheel and the shaft back into the insert.

steps.name: Install Fresh Cotton
steps.hint: Pack the fresh white cotton into the tank.

steps.name: Spray the GenZ Finish
steps.hint: Spray an even coat over the case and lid.

steps.name: Lid Motion Check
steps.hint: Flip the lid open, then snap it shut. Do it twice.

steps.name: Before and After
steps.hint: Drag the slider across to compare the object you started with against your restoration.

steps.name: Remove the Damaged Crystal
steps.hint: Lift the scratched crystal off the bezel.

steps.name: Open the Back Cover
steps.hint: Turn the case back counter-clockwise to unscrew it.

steps.name: Remove the Movement
steps.hint: Lift the movement out through the open back.

steps.name: Remove the Hands
steps.hint: Lift each hand off the centre post with the tweezers.

steps.name: Clean the Dial
steps.hint: Gently brush the dust and spots off the dial.

steps.name: Restore the Bracelet
steps.hint: Scrub the links clean and bright.

steps.name: Polish the Case
steps.hint: Rub in small circles for a premium shine.

steps.name: Install the Hands
steps.hint: Drop each hand onto the centre post.

steps.name: Install the New Crystal
steps.hint: Press the clear new crystal into the bezel.

steps.name: Final Time Check
steps.hint: Wind the crown in circles and watch the hands move.

steps.name: Before and After
steps.hint: Drag the slider across to compare the object you started with against your restoration.

steps.name: Pop Off the Keycaps
steps.hint: Tap each glowing key to pop it off. The rest follow.

steps.name: Brush Out the Hair & Crumbs
steps.hint: Sweep the brush over the plate to clear the crumbs and dust.

steps.name: Singe the Last Hairs
steps.hint: Hold the little flame over each hair until it curls away.

steps.name: Unscrew the Case
steps.hint: Press and hold each corner screw.

steps.name: Run It Through the Dishwasher
steps.hint: Tap the shell, base and plate to load them, then hold the button to wash.

steps.name: Peroxide & UV Bath
steps.hint: Lower the keyboard into the peroxide, then hold the button to switch on the UV lamps.

steps.name: Polish the LED Window
steps.hint: Hold the polishing pad on the hazy LED window until it is clear.

steps.name: Click the Keycaps Back On
steps.hint: Tap the glowing slots to press keys back on. The rest snap in by themselves.

steps.name: Typing Test
steps.hint: Type THANKYOU on the glowing keys.

steps.name: Before and After
steps.hint: Drag the slider across to compare the object you started with against your restoration.

steps.name: Pull Out the Movement
steps.hint: Pry the back cover off, then pull the movement out of the case.

steps.name: Tweeze Out the Gears
steps.hint: Tap each brass wheel to lift it out with the tweezers.

steps.name: Citric Acid Bath
steps.hint: Lower the movement into the jar, then swirl until the rust dissolves.

steps.name: Polish the Brass
steps.hint: Buff the plates and both bells in small circles until they shine.

steps.name: Braze the Rust Holes
steps.hint: Trace the torch around each hole: molten brass fills it.

steps.name: Fill & Sand Smooth
steps.hint: Sand the filled case smooth, rust and all.

steps.name: Spray Gloss Black
steps.hint: Spray an even coat of gloss black over the case.

steps.name: Fit the New Dial & Hands
steps.hint: Drop the movement, the new dial, each hand and the glass into place.

steps.name: Wind It & Ring It
steps.hint: Circle around the winding key to wind the clock. It ticks, then rings!

steps.name: Before and After
steps.hint: Drag the slider across to compare the object you started with against your restoration.

steps.name: Snip the Rusty Strings
steps.hint: Tap each string to snip it. It springs loose.

steps.name: Strip the Hardware
steps.hint: Pull the pickguard, the bridge and the neck off the body.

steps.name: Brush On Paint Stripper
steps.hint: Brush the stripper over the whole top. The old finish blisters.

steps.name: Scrape Off the Old Paint
steps.hint: Push the scraper across the body. The paint peels off in ribbons.

steps.name: Sand to Bare Wood
steps.hint: Sand the body until the wood is clean and smooth.

steps.name: Spray Metallic Red
steps.hint: Sweep the spray gun over the body for a deep gloss red.

steps.name: Polish the Pickup Poles
steps.hint: Hold the felt wheel on each pickup until its rusty poles turn to chrome.

steps.name: Press In New Frets
steps.hint: Press each new fret in when the needle crosses the green.

steps.name: String Up & Tune
steps.hint: Circle around each glowing peg until the tuner needle sits in the green.

steps.name: Strum a Chord
steps.hint: Swipe across all six strings over the pickups.

steps.name: Before and After
steps.hint: Drag the slider across to compare the object you started with against your restoration.

steps.name: Lift Off the Carriage
steps.hint: Lift the carriage straight up and off the machine.

steps.name: Pull the Typebars
steps.hint: Tap the marked typebars to pull them out. The rest follow.

steps.name: Rust-Remover Jar
steps.hint: Lower the typebars into the jar, then swirl until they come out clean.

steps.name: Sandblast the Panels
steps.hint: Sweep the sandblaster over the body until it is bare grey metal.

steps.name: Spray Gloss Black
steps.hint: Spray an even coat of gloss black.

steps.name: Laser the Olympia Logo
steps.hint: Trace the laser along the script to burn the logo back in.

steps.name: Oil the Key Pivots
steps.hint: Tap each pivot point to put a drop of oil on it.

steps.name: Refit the Carriage
steps.hint: Drop the carriage back onto its rails.

steps.name: Typing Test
steps.hint: Type RESTORED on the glowing keys.

steps.name: Before and After
steps.hint: Drag the slider across to compare the object you started with against your restoration.

steps.name: Pick Off Heavy Corrosion
steps.hint: Scratch each crust of rust until it breaks away.

steps.name: Apply Cleaning Compound
steps.hint: Spread the compound over the metal.

steps.name: Straighten the Exterior
steps.hint: Hold the press on each highlighted bend.

steps.name: Repair the Exterior Cracks
steps.hint: Trace each highlighted crack to fill it.

steps.name: Grind the Repair Marks
steps.hint: Hold the grinder on each raised seam until it is flush.

steps.name: Polish the Exterior Metal
steps.hint: Rub the metal in circles until it gleams.

steps.name: Apply the Final Finish
steps.hint: Brush the protective finish over stock and barrel.

steps.name: Reassemble Cosmetic Parts
steps.hint: Fit the new butt cap, ramrod and side pins.

steps.name: Mechanical Presentation Check
steps.hint: Tap the hammer and the frizzen to see them move.

steps.name: Before / After Reveal
steps.hint: Drag the slider to see the full transformation.
